title: Characterization of DNA processing protein A (DprA) of the radiation-resistant bacterium Deinococcus radiodurans
authors: Dhirendra Kumar Sharma; Hari S. Misra; Yogendra S. Rajpurohit
one_liner_zh: 该文表征耐辐射奇球菌DprA蛋白的DNA结合与RecA互作功能，属广义蛋白-DNA互作研究，但以湿实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，与TF-DNA建模课题关联有限。
abstract: The uptake of environmental DNA (eDNA) by certain bacteria and its integration into their genome creates genetic diversity and new phenotypes. A DNA processing protein A (DprA) is part of a multiprotein complex and facilitate natural transformation (NT) phenotype in most bacteria. The Deinococcus radiodurans, an extremely radioresistant bacterium, is efficient in N T, and its genome encodes nearly all the components of the natural competence complex. Here, we have characterized the DprA of this bacterium (DrDprA) for the known characteristics of DprA proteins in other bacteria and the mechanisms underlying its roles in the transformation of eDNA into the bacterial genome. DrDprA is found to be a unique domain organization implicating some unique functions compared with DprA of other bacteria. In vitro studies showed that the purified recombinant DrDprA binds to both ssDNA and dsDNA with nearly equal affinity and protects ssDNA from nucleolytic degradation. DrDprA showed a strong interaction with DrRecA indicating its role in RecA catalyzed functions in vivo . Mutational studies identified amino acid residues responsible for its oligomerization, interaction with DrRecA, and DNA binding characteristics of DrDprA. Further, we demonstrated that both oligomerization and DNA binding properties of DrDprA are integral to its support in DrRecA catalyzed strand exchange reaction (SER) in vitro. These results suggested that DrDprA is largely structurally conserved with DprA homologs but showed some unique structure-function features like additional domain, the same affinity to ss/ds DNA and both oligomerization and DNA binding domains collectively contribute to its support in DrRecA functions.
abstract_zh: 某些细菌对环境DNA（eDNA）的摄取及其整合到其基因组中，产生了遗传多样性和新表型。DNA加工蛋白A（DprA）是多蛋白复合物的一部分，并在大多数细菌中促进自然转化（NT）表型。耐辐射奇球菌（Deinococcus radiodurans）是一种极端抗辐射的细菌，在NT方面高效，其基因组编码了自然感受态复合物的几乎所有组分。在此，我们对该细菌的DprA（DrDprA）进行了表征，针对其他细菌中DprA蛋白的已知特性及其在eDNA转化为细菌基因组过程中的作用机制进行了研究。发现DrDprA具有独特的结构域组织，暗示其与其他细菌的DprA相比具有一些独特功能。体外研究表明，纯化的重组DrDprA以几乎相同的亲和力结合ssDNA和dsDNA，并保护ssDNA免受核酸酶降解。DrDprA与DrRecA表现出强相互作用，表明其在体内RecA催化功能中的作用。突变研究确定了负责其寡聚化、与DrRecA相互作用以及DrDprA DNA结合特性的氨基酸残基。此外，我们证明了DrDprA的寡聚化和DNA结合特性均对其在体外DrRecA催化的链交换反应（SER）中的支持作用不可或缺。这些结果表明，DrDprA在结构上大体上与DprA同源物保守，但显示出一些独特的结构-功能特征，如额外结构域、对ss/ds DNA的相同亲和力，以及寡聚化和DNA结合结构域共同促进其在DrRecA功能中的支持作用。
